title: Onboarding bridgework sync notes — 2026-09-14
content:
Meeting: Onboarding Bridgework Sync (weekly)
Date: 2026-09-14 10:30-11:00 PT
Facilitator: Priya Desai
Attendees: Priya, Marco, Ruth, Daniel, Sofia, Ezra (Customer Success)

Purpose: quick cadence to surface integration status for active customers in onboarding runway; escalate infra/ops blockers and confirm next steps for deploy windows.

High-level summary:
- Three active onboardings covered: StratusDocs (pilot), Thirdwave Fin (dedicated), Clearview Retail (hosted -> private migration).
- Overall momentum good; two customers have infra-dependent blockers that need SRE support and cert rotation windows.
- Action alignment: infra tickets created, two immediate canaries scheduled next Tue/Thu.

Customer breakouts:
1) StratusDocs (pilot) — owner: Marco
- Status: API contract signed; model pinned to v1.3-beta for evaluation.
- Blocker: intermittent 429s observed from staging when simulating 750 rps (batching disabled in test harness). Suspect rate-limiter config mismatch on dedicated gateway.
- Next steps: Marco to open seeding load test with SRE (INFRA-1029) and share load profile by EOD 2026-09-15.
- Action: SRE (Danielle) assigned to review gateway rate-limit rules; tentative fix window 2026-09-16 02:00-04:00 PT.

2) Thirdwave Fin (dedicated reserve) — owner: Ruth
- Status: Dedicated pool provisioned, autoscaler tuning in progress. Baseline throughput tests show 12% lower token throughput than bench.
- Blocker: quantization mismatch between customer-compiled model (q4f16) and our runtime's kernel selection causing occasional CUDA kernel fallback and CPU spill.
- Mitigation: roll forward to q8_0 for canary tomorrow; Ruth to coordinate with Applied ML (Amit) to patch kernel selection heuristic (PR linked).
- Action: Ruth -> PR review (serving-runtime PR#4278), deploy canary on 3 instances 2026-09-16.

3) Clearview Retail (hosted -> private migration) — owner: Daniel
- Status: Private control plane onboarding started; VPC peering in progress.
- Blocker: egress policy for model downloads blocked by customer's firewall; needs customer network team to allow s3-download endpoints and port 443.
- Notes: cert rotation schedule required for internal CA (customer requested end-of-month rotation). We flagged potential downtime for 30m during rotation.
- Action: Daniel to draft rotation playbook and confirm avoidance window with customer by 2026-09-17.

Cross-customer items / platform notes:
- KV cache invalidation: observed miss rate spike after a model version bump in staging. Root cause appears to be prefix hashing change in model shim. Applied ML to stabilize shim by 2026-09-18.
- Routing policy test: canaries for latency-aware fallback ran stable at 95th percentile but showed token-cost regression when fallback to quantized variant occurred. Need to add cost delta into routing decision (Optimize team).
- Observability: token-level billing traces missing on a small subset of requests due to sampler mismatch. Marco to file JIRA with example traces.

Open blockers (priority):
- P0: Rate-limit 429s for StratusDocs load test (owner: Marco) — infra ticket INFRA-1029, ETA triage 9/15.
- P1: Quantization kernel fallback for Thirdwave Fin (owner: Ruth) — requires PR merge and canary (linked PR).
- P1: Network egress allowlist for Clearview (owner: Daniel) — awaiting customer confirmation.

Action item register (concise):
- Marco: share load profile + repro steps for 429s (due 2026-09-15).
- Ruth: coordinate PR review + schedule canary (due 2026-09-16).
- Daniel: rotation playbook + customer window (due 2026-09-17).
- Priya: raise routing cost-delta ask with Optimize PM (Karim) and capture expected behavior in rollout policy doc (due 2026-09-18).
- Sofia: draft internal comms for cert rotation impact and customer-facing FAQ (due 2026-09-17).

Risks / notes to escalate:
- If kernel fallback persists, Thirdwave may request a temporary capacity uplift to meet SLAs — cost implications to be pre-approved by finance (scoped estimate pending).
- Multiple customers requiring rotation/peering windows in the same week increase SRE on-call load — recommend we batch low-risk ops to off-peak windows where possible.

Decisions made:
- Proceed with q8_0 canary for Thirdwave Fin to avoid CUDA fallback until kernel selection fix ships.
- Approve temporary increased reserved capacity for 48 hours if canary shows regression (finance okayed emergency credit).

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Draft standardized onboarding checklist for private migrations (Priya + Daniel) — include egress checklist, cert rotation template, peering validation steps.
- Add a short section to the Playbook for expected cost delta when routing to quantized variants.

Next meeting: 2026-09-21 10:30 PT
Proposed agenda: follow-ups on action register, canary results, KV cache shim status, routing cost-delta proposal.

Notes captured by: Priya Desai
Quick link to notes: Confluence link (draft): /display/SE/Onboarding+Bridgework+Weekly

Informal / quick thoughts (notes-to-self style):
- Need a small runbook snippet for customers explaining why quantized fallback may be more costly in tokens (surprising to finance folks).
- Consider centralizing cert rotation notifications to avoid duplicate emails to customer ops.
